card.name: Points where a software name is expected
card.fires_on: Words in computer how-to text just before a software product or program name, such as Download, Microsoft, free, program, or version. It fires where the next word is likely a software title.

modes.label: Before a program name
modes.description: Words like free, program, or download that lead into a named software tool.
